verdict.rationale: Rippling's own pages describe event-triggered automation. Custom workflows notify people and automate tasks, such as triggering a bonus reminder or a Slack alert from a Zendesk ticket. Supergroup rules automatically adjust app permissions as roles change, and accounts are provisioned and deprovisioned automatically across the employee lifecycle. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the rule/trigger builder (available event types, conditions, actions), independent or hands-on corroboration that workflows behave as marketed, and any AI-assisted rule authoring.
